title: Free Night Awards Redemption Eligibility Standard
content:
The conditions under which one of the Free Night Awards may be applied to a night, and how the night's price is measured against the award's cap.

## Conditions

| Condition | What must hold | Where it is shown |
|---|---|---|
| Who asks | The award is applied only at the request of the member holding it | The member holding the award |
| Reservation | A night of a Reward Night Rate reservation whose status is confirmed | The reservation record: rate plan and status |
| Same membership | The Ashbury Rewards membership attached to the reservation is the award's membership | The reservation record and the award record |
| Guest name | The night may be booked for another guest's name where the award type's terms allow a guest other than the member on the member's reservation | The award type's terms |
| Award status | The award must be issued | The award record |
| Membership status | The membership must be active where the award type's terms allow application only while the membership is active | The Ashbury Rewards membership record |
| Validity | The night covered must fall on or before the award's expiry date | The award record |
| Room type | One of the room types the award type may pay | The reservation record |
| Adults | Not more than the most adults of the award type | The reservation record |
| Season | One of the award seasons in which the award type may be used | The reservation record |
| Brand | Not one of the hotel brands the award type excludes | The reservation record |
| Channel | One of the channels through which an award night can be booked | The reservation record |
| Group block | The reservation names no group block where the award type is not usable inside a group block | The reservation record |
| Advance | The award is applied at least the award type's minimum days before the night | The night and the date of application |

Each condition rests on the system records named, read before the award is applied.

## The night's price and the cap

**Price clause (no longer in force).** The former clause under which the night's price was the standard-room points price of the Ashbury Rewards award chart for the reservation's award category and award season, recorded on the hold, is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current basis for the price recorded on the hold.

**Cover.** An uncapped award covers any price. A capped award covers the night when the price does not exceed the award type's points cap. When the price does exceed the cap and the award type permits top-off, the difference is added as top-off points from the holder's own account, provided the difference does not exceed the award type's most top-off points and the member's points balance covers it; otherwise the award cannot pay that night.

The top-off points are nil for an uncapped award; for a capped award they are the amount by which the price exceeds the cap, and nil when the price does not exceed the cap.

### Cover cases (hypothetical award with a cap of 30000 points and a top-off allowance of 15000 points)

| Night price | Points balance | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 28000 | Any | Covered; no top-off |
| 30000 | Any | Covered; no top-off, the price equals the cap |
| 39000 | 12000 | Covered with 9000 top-off points: the difference is within the allowance and the balance covers it |
| 39000 | 5000 | Cannot pay the night: the balance does not cover the 9000 difference |
| 46000 | 20000 | Cannot pay the night: the 16000 difference exceeds the allowance |

superseded_clauses: The night's price is the standard-room points price of the Ashbury Rewards award chart for the reservation's award_category and award_season, and it is recorded on the hold.
